revenue_model: Free-to-play base game with optional ethically-priced cosmetic items, audio-visual expansions, and narrative side-story DLC packs. Zero pay-to-win, zero energy systems, and zero predatory pressure tactics.
ethical_principles: Strict Zero Pay-to-Win: All monetization is strictly limited to cosmetic customization, soundtracks, and side-story narrative expansions; no gameplay advantage can ever be purchased.

Cultural Preservation & Protection: Sacred, spiritual, and core historical cultural traditions are integrated authentically into the base game for all players and will never be paywalled or commercialized.
No Artificial Friction or Timers: The game never sells energy refills, speed-ups, inventory expansion fees, or time-gated skips, maintaining a calm, respect-first gameplay loop.
Transparent & Fair Pricing: All items are sold as direct-purchase microtransactions with clear real-world dollar prices. No obscure premium currency conversions or loot boxes.

iap_catalog.name: Handwoven Inabel Outfit Pack
iap_catalog.description: A set of three traditional textile-inspired garments featuring intricate handwoven patterns for character customization.

iap_catalog.name: Ancestral Hearth Decoration Set
iap_catalog.description: Decorative heirloom furniture, carved bamboo benches, and ambient oil lamps to customize your village meeting hall.

iap_catalog.name: Echoes of the Archipelago Original Soundtrack
iap_catalog.description: Unlocks full high-fidelity soundtrack files, original kulintang music tracks, and an in-game village music player.

iap_catalog.name: Tales of the Ancient Seafarers Lore Expansion
iap_catalog.description: An optional side-narrative chapter exploring forgotten island legends, complete with extra dialogue and interactive lore journals.

iap_catalog.name: Barangay Weaver's Wardrobe
iap_catalog.description: A collection of ceremonial headwear, indigo-dyed shawls, and maritime accessory skins.

iap_catalog.name: Spirits of the Mangrove Haven Kit
iap_catalog.description: Village flora decoration kit containing bioluminescent mangrove saplings, tidal stone sculptures, and garden paths.

iap_catalog.name: Voyager's Digital Artbook & Journal
iap_catalog.description: In-game interactive art viewer featuring developer concept sketches, world maps, and developer commentary notes.

iap_catalog.name: Celestial Navigator Ensemble
iap_catalog.description: Starlight-embroidered ceremonial garments and customizable star-chart sail trims for your trading vessel.

seasonal_events.name: Habagat Monsoon Surge
seasonal_events.description: An in-game seasonal event aligned with the southwest monsoon cycle, introducing high-tide fishing mechanics and stormy trading routes.

seasonal_events.name: Amihan Trade Winds Fair
seasonal_events.description: A seasonal event marking the cool northeast trade winds, featuring island merchant gatherings and traditional boat crafting challenges.

seasonal_events.name: Paglakbay Celestial Equinox
seasonal_events.description: An astronomical seasonal cycle celebrating ancient star navigation traditions, unlocking nighttime sky observation quests for all players.

battle_pass_recommendation: A traditional battle pass is NOT recommended due to FOMO mechanisms and daily grind pressure. If introduced, it must be a permanent, non-expiring 'Seafarer's Chronicle' progression path where players can unlock rewards at their own pace without time limits or paid skips.
ads_policy: Zero mandatory or intrusive pop-up ads. Optional rewarded video ads are strictly prohibited to protect immersive narrative flow and respect player attention.
